# Nula CRM

> Nula is a friendly, AI-first CRM for small businesses. It organizes contacts, suggests next steps, and helps you follow up without the CRM headache.

## Business info

- Name: Nula CRM
- Email: info@nulacrm.ai
- Website: https://www.nulacrm.ai

## Services

- AI-first CRM for small business owners and teams. Tell Nula what you need in plain English. You preview and approve every action before it runs.
- Lead follow-up, smart segmentation, and outreach campaigns (reactivation and nurture) drafted for you.
- Contacts, companies, deals, tags, groups, a unified inbox, automations, and reports.
- B2B Intelligence add-on ($49/month, 250 enrichments included): fills in industry, company size, revenue, and job title, scores fit, and recommends the next step.
- Pricing: $29 per user per month, or $24 per user per month billed annually ($290/user/year). AI is included. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
